description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus replay-backed fragment flow, convergence-aware assembly planning and transplantable fragment geometry for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

fragmentIndex.purpose: Catalog reusable fragment mechanisms with evidence and representative canonical geometry.

representativeGeometry.bounds: relative q/r bounds over part origins
representativeGeometry.parts: canonical solution-part payload including relative positions, rotations, programs, track and conduit geometry

representativeSelection: within a level prefer fewer parts, then fewer instructions

fragmentFlowIndex.purpose: Catalog replay-observed transitions plus same-solution convergence motifs.

convergenceAwareAssembly.purpose: Construct replay-backed DAG candidates when multiple reagent streams must converge.

geometryTransplant.purpose: Provide a relative, orientation-normalized mechanism template that can be placed into a new puzzle layout.
nextValidation: select compatible representative geometries for every node in an assembly DAG
solve relative transforms between connected fragment anchors
write a candidate solution and validate replay/OMSim/collisions
limitations: Representative geometry is evidence-backed historical geometry, not yet proof that independently selected fragments can coexist without overlap.
Canonical bounds currently summarize part origins; exact occupied-cell bounds remain a downstream placement concern.
Program synchronization across multiple fragments is not yet solved.
